caseNameFull: Ex parte: In the Matter of The Cudahy Packing Company
attorneys: Mr. Ralph W. Breckenridge and Mr. Charles J. Greene for petitioner., Mr. Constantine J. Smyth and Mr. Edward P. Smith for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for a writ of mandamus denied, rule discharged, and petition dismissed, on the authority of In re Pennsylvania Company, Petitioner &c., 137 U. S. 451.

Mr. Constantine J. Smyth and Mr. Edward P. Smith for respondent.
